sections.content: More family words with the 'my' pattern: férj → férjem (my husband), feleség → feleségem (my wife), nagymama → nagymamám (my grandmother), nagypapa → nagypapám (my grandfather).
sections.title: In-laws and grandparents

sections.content: nagymama and nagypapa are built from nagy ('big/grand') plus mama/papa — spotting nagy- helps you guess related words later, like nagybácsi (uncle).
